The strategy employs a heuristic-based optimization approach using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to address the nonconvex nature of the overlap integral. By maintaining population diversity, PSO effectively explores the solution space to avoid local minima and locate regions with lower overlap integrals. The approach balances exploration and exploitation, dynamically adjusting search parameters based on population feedback.

Key advantages:
- Handles nonconvexity without requiring gradient information
- Leverages population-based search to discover diverse candidates
- Focuses on feasible regions via constraint repair mechanisms
- Efficiently handles the 70-variable optimization problem within time/budget constraints

- Heuristic nature means no guarantee of global optimum
